items.html: We shall first explain how these thirteen corrections of the beard attach themselves to the corrections of the head, as above — that the ten Sefirot of the head bestow and shine within the ten Sefirot of the beard, for from the place where the ten Sefirot of the head end, the corrections of the beard begin, as mentioned there. It was also explained there that the ten Sefirot of the head are ten internal Sefirot and also ten encompassing Sefirot; and I did not receive their order.
